en: Led development of the Budget Module from scratch (~50 tasks): full CRUD lifecycle (monthly/annual), comparative and chronological reporting, bulk data import, and multi-accounting with multi-currency support.
Built report system with preview, advanced filters, Excel download via S3 pre-signed URLs, and zero-balance toggle.
Developed bulk import pipeline: S3 upload → AWS Lambda async processing → AWS AppSync + Amplify real-time polling → visual progress feedback.
Integrated AI-powered assisted budget entry, compatibility validation, model training notifications, and predictive reporting features.
Implemented real-time AWS AppSync subscriptions for automatic UI refresh after AI processing.
Delivered Approval Flow Module (OC & RIM, ~15 tasks): CRUD operations, state transitions, amount-range validation, reset endpoints, and onboarding tours using reactour.
Migrated cascade balance recalculation endpoint to AWS Lambda URL for improved scalability and performance.
Resolved ~10 production bugs involving deletion issues, form validation, duplicate requests, and decimal precision handling.
es: Lideré el desarrollo del módulo de Presupuesto desde cero (~50 tareas): ciclo CRUD completo (mensual/anual), reportes comparativos y cronológicos, importación masiva y soporte multi-moneda/multi-contabilidad.
Construí sistema de reportes con preview, filtros avanzados, descarga Excel mediante URLs pre-firmadas S3 y opción de balance cero.
Desarrollé pipeline de importación masiva: S3 upload → procesamiento async Lambda → polling en tiempo real con AppSync + Amplify → feedback visual de progreso.
Integré funcionalidades IA para asistencia de presupuestos, validaciones de compatibilidad y reportes predictivos.
Implementé subscriptions AWS AppSync en tiempo real para actualización automática de interfaz tras procesos IA.
Entregué módulo Approval Flow (OC & RIM, ~15 tareas): CRUD, validaciones, transiciones de estado, reset endpoints y onboarding tours con reactour.
Migré endpoint de recálculo balance cascade hacia AWS Lambda URL mejorando escalabilidad y performance.
Resolví ~10 bugs productivos relacionados a validaciones, requests duplicados y manejo decimal.

Built adaptive chatbot conversation flows using Botpress.
Fixed critical ERP bugs, reducing system-wide errors by 20%.
Participated in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including standups, sprint planning, and demos.

Participé activamente en ceremonias Agile/Scrum.
